description:
Job Description Summary 
You will design, build, and maintain the Data Cloud Connector (DCC), the service that moves clinical data from hospital systems into GE HealthCare's cloud. That data powers the analytics and AI tools clinicians use to make decisions about real patients. You will work across the full software lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, and production support, on a distributed system that runs in hospitals around the world. Healthcare data standards are a big part of the work, and you do not need to know them coming in. 
 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 In this role, you will:
 Collaborate with system engineers, frontend developers, and software developers to build solutions that extend our shared platforms
 Write clean, tested code that meets team standards using the technologies selected for the project
 Build and maintain backend features such as web services and database queries
 Apply SDLC best practices including continuous integration, security, scalability, refactoring, and documentation
 Assess and improve application performance against defined targets
 Apply core data structures and algorithms to solve practical engineering problems
 
 Education and Experience 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a STEM field, with a minimum of 2 years of software engineering experience.
 
 Technical Expertise 
 Hands-on experience with Java and/or Python, and with AWS cloud services
 Proficient with Git and modern source control workflows (branching, pull requests, code review) using GitHub and/or GitLab
 Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent)
 Working knowledge of automated testing at the unit, integration, end-to-end levels, and behavior-driven testing (e.g. Cucumber)
 Experience delivering software in an Agile environment (Scrum, Kanban, XP, or Lean)
 Understanding of how technology and tooling choices affect development speed, quality, and maintainability
 
 Desired Characteristics 
 Breaks down complex problems and provides realistic estimates for development tasks
 Seeks to understand a problem fully before building, and asks clarifying questions when requirements are ambiguous
 Voices opinions with clear rationale, using data and evidence to influence
 Takes independent ownership of deliverables and completes them on time and at high quality
 Stays current on technology trends and brings new ideas and frameworks to the team
 Adapts quickly to changing requirements and is receptive to coaching
 Understands the product's value to the customer and connects their own work to the team's goals
 
 We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $103,040.00-$154,560 Annual.
